GREG, 2026-11-15 about 20:34Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1299, message 41ec6baf), verbatim: „super! to jest normalne, ze znajdujemy inneficencies ALE prosilbym zespoly o nie tworzenie systemow co nieskaluja sie z liczba wykonywanej pracy. inny przyklad do sync, ktory powien byc incremental, a nie byl...”
JOINT DESIGN REQUIREMENT, for both projects (Asistant's brief, a paraphrase):
- Routine operations work in proportion to the changes or the actually pending work, NOT to the whole growing history.
- Where a full read is genuinely needed, state the reason and a measurable bound.
- Kimi works with both teams to apply this: review the existing hot paths and take the matching measurements. No added procedural gates.
- Report concrete results. Sync and EO stay first.
Today's examples: Central's history-scanning causal pull, now being replaced by a pending set (TermAl w-05ff); incremental task-sync (dd205), which should have been proportional from the start; and the w-ea4a design, where a projection index was rejected in favour of a forward-only root-feed append.
How Engram::Fable applies it: any new design or review brief names its cost model (what grows the work) and refuses history-proportional routine paths unless a reason and a bound are recorded.
